name: Course Copilot — Roleplay Brief
description: Turns one roleplay slot of an approved Course Copilot blueprint into the actor brief the Agent Builder field chain takes: one fictional client written the way a trainer fills in "Describe roleplay actor", encoding the slot's task class (cooperative → ambivalent → distressed; one concern → several), the audience and the behaviours being practised, plus agent test cases, a title, persona gender/age and a difficulty. JSON mode.
